scripts.build: pnpm clean && pnpm typecheck && pnpm --filter './packages/*' build && pnpm --filter './apps/*' build
scripts.dev:api: pnpm build && concurrently --kill-others --names types,platform,ordering,api-build,api "tsc -b --watch --emitDeclarationOnly --preserveWatchOutput" "pnpm --filter @afds-nest-starter/platform build:watch" "pnpm --filter @afds-nest-starter/ordering build:watch" "pnpm --filter @afds-nest-starter/api build:watch" "pnpm --filter @afds-nest-starter/api dev"
scripts.dev:worker: pnpm build && concurrently --kill-others --names types,platform,worker-build,worker "tsc -b --watch --emitDeclarationOnly --preserveWatchOutput" "pnpm --filter @afds-nest-starter/platform build:watch" "pnpm --filter @afds-nest-starter/outbox-worker build:watch" "pnpm --filter @afds-nest-starter/outbox-worker dev"
scripts.dev:consumer: pnpm build && concurrently --kill-others --names types,platform,consumer-build,consumer "tsc -b --watch --emitDeclarationOnly --preserveWatchOutput" "pnpm --filter @afds-nest-starter/platform build:watch" "pnpm --filter @afds-nest-starter/order-activity-consumer build:watch" "pnpm --filter @afds-nest-starter/order-activity-consumer dev"
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm check:boundaries && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm validate:docs && pnpm build
